job.question: According to the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP, how many participants did the plan have and what were its total assets?
job.expected_facts: As of December 31, 2022: 4,398 plan participants and plan assets of $308,676,730. In addition, the OBRA part-time seasonal plan had 536 participants with assets of $926,785.
job.acceptance: Main plan 4,398 participants / $308,676,730 is sufficient. OBRA 536 / $926,785 is supplementary and must not replace or be silently added to main-plan figures.

reviews.reason: This is an August 2021 investment consultant services RFP issued by the Orange County Employees Retirement System, not the Monroe County deferred compensation services RFP. Its membership and asset figures concern OCERS and a different reporting date; it does not support the requested plan figures.
quotes: Issued August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
OCERS is requesting proposals from qualified firms interested in providing pension fund investment consulting services
There are approximately 42,000 members served by OCERS, of which over 15,000 are retirees.
As of June 30, 2021, OCERS’ portfolio had a net asset value of $21.5 billion.
